scope: One runtime-authored AC1027 DXF source with two root-reachable MLEADERSTYLE records. STANDARD has one existing group-42 landingGap value 1.25 and an opaque group-302 tag; SECONDARY is unchanged. Supports a standalone typed landingGap change from 1.25 to 4.5.

fieldEvidence.source: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference, MLEADERSTYLE group codes
fieldEvidence.classification: DXF field role corroboration; not a producer sample or native semantic acceptance

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The selected record must be reachable through the validated ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary, have one source-matched raw body and immutable source baseline, and contain one finite DOUBLE group 42 within exactly one AcDbMLeaderStyle subclass. landingGap must be the only changed typed payload field; table-entry identity, common fields, handles, application data, extension data and all other encoded style fields must match the source.
contract.projection: Replace only the existing physical group-42 value in a copy of the captured raw body. Preserve all other ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing or repeated group 42, unknown subclass grammar, non-AC1027 route, another typed edit, or a simultaneous group-45 edit remains outside this transaction.
contract.outputAndReadback: Inspect the staged OBJECTS body against every retained raw field and mapped handle, then decode the emitted MLEADERSTYLE and require group-42 landingGap to equal the planned value. Fresh readback proves the typed value, one literal group-42 field with value 4.5, and preservation of opaque group 302.
contract.failureAndRetry: An edited raw group 42 that differs from its immutable baseline refuses while preserving a sentinel destination. A simultaneous typed textHeight edit refuses atomically. A late typed landingGap mutation after preflight also refuses without replacing the destination; restoring the requested value permits same-adapter retry. The focused selector runs both source encodings and both target encodings, including ASCII-to-binary and binary-to-ASCII.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE records keep the existing raw replay route. Transactions are not admitted for other source or target versions, nor are multiple scalar edits on one record. The typed DWG-origin writer and existing fail-closed behavior remain unchanged. Test sources and outputs are authored at runtime in a temporary directory and removed; no drawing fixture is committed.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp, with two root dictionary entries, existing typed references, STANDARD group 42=1.25, SECONDARY with default landingGap, and distinct group-302 opaque tags; ASCII and binary inputs are generated locally from scratch.
